children: Gamuda's latest Sydney Metro job win lifts its outstanding order book to a record 61.6 billion ringgit, strengthening earnings visibility, CIMB Securities analyst Kenny Mak Hoy Ken says in a note. The Parramatta integrated station development project is Gamuda's third major Sydney Metro contract and brings its Sydney Metro West station packages to six of nine, he says. New wins have reached 9.3 billion ringgit since August, putting Gamuda on track to exceed its 50 billion ringgit year-end order-book target, he reckons. Near-term earnings should be supported by 7 billion ringgit of data-center jobs and continuing progress billings, he adds. CIMB maintains a buy rating on Gamuda and keeps its target price at 6.00 ringgit. Shares are 0.2% lower at 4.61 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
